metadata.title: Student and school-level factors to predict science literacy for two top-performing countries in PISA 2015 Finland and Singapore

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used 10 plausible values for the dependent variable and applied Rubin's rules for combining them.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it applies sampling weights due to the two-stage stratified random sampling design of PISA.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study utilized Hierarchical Linear Modeling (HLM) to account for the hierarchical clustering of students within schools.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and only discusses internal validation methods.
